risk_note: RV2 by PR (platform/events and platform/queue, orders port; notification RV1). notification consumes claim.resolved (EVENT_SUBSCRIPTIONS entry, evt.notification-claim-result queue and worker, wired on the worker entry only) and writes the BR-TEXT-09 CLAIM_RESULT inbox message to the claim applicant: approved -> 订单找回成功，预估返 {rebate} with the applicant's own share in the current commission version summed over the approved items' orders (read through the B1-12j read-only ports, integer fen formatted per BR-TEXT-10); rejected -> 订单找回未通过：{reason} from the first rejected item by created_at and id, mapped to claim_reject_reason.<CODE>.title (fallback text when the code has no dictionary value); cancelled and other statuses send nothing. notify_logs (dedupe_key claim.resolved:<event_id>) and inbox_messages are written in one transaction; inbox only, no push or SMS. readNotifyClaimFacts now reads the claim and its items in one statement (B1-12j review S2). The handler loads the orders and commission public index modules at call time (keeps the rule-test project free of decorator-bearing imports); the Codex review checked the production path. The two platform contract tests add only this subscription, queue and worker (ledger test_paths; class 1, label checked by the orchestrator under approvals #24). No money movement, no attribution change.
